identity.package: SOIC-8 (TI package D, drawing D0008A, JEDEC MS-012 variation AA)
identity.variant_notes: Generic SOIC-8 3D model pair from the official KiCad library (kicad StepUp export, 2017), not TI CAD.

acquisition.tag_choice: The KiCad 9 3D library ships STEP only (no WRL at 9.0.9), and the web viewer renders WRL only. 8.0.9 is the latest tag with a matched STEP+WRL pair from one export. The 9.0.9 STEP is a different, regenerated file and is not paired with the 8.0.9 WRL.

representation.units: STEP: millimetre (SI_UNIT .MILLI. .METRE.); WRL: 0.1 inch per unit (KiCad VRML convention, 1 unit = 2.54 mm)

fidelity.reason: A generic JEDEC MS-012AA SOIC-8 body produced by kicad StepUp, not a TI model of TMP1075DR. Its extents fall inside the D0008A outline, which shows it represents the package family; it does not prove the exact part.
evidence: WRL extents recomputed on 2026-09-26 from every point list (156 shapes, 1856 points), converted at 2.54 mm per unit: overall x -3.000..+3.000 mm, y -2.451..+2.451 mm, z 0.000..1.750 mm
src-tmp1075-ds-outline (SBOS854F physical page index 38, D0008A 4214825/C): lead-tip span 5.80-6.19 mm, body 4.81-5.00 x 3.81-3.98 mm, height 1.75 mm max, standoff 0.11-0.25 mm (.004-.010 in)

derivation.tool_version: repository script, run with Node.js v24.13.1

parameters.transformation: inline each 'material USE <name>' with the body of its 'material DEF <name> Material { ... }' (3 materials, 156 references); the publication policy refuses VRML USE
parameters.geometry: unchanged: every point and coordIndex list is byte-identical to the original
parameters.step: not derived; the STEP is the unmodified 8.0.9 file

cad_use.seating_plane: z = 0: the lead bottoms (PIN-01 minimum z) sit on the footprint plane; the body underside is at z = 0.099 mm

performed: Units: WRL bbox converted from 0.1-inch units (x +/-1.181, y +/-0.965, z 0..0.689 units) to mm; STEP declares millimetres
Lead-tip span 6.000 mm: inside D0008A 5.80-6.19 mm
Height 1.750 mm above the seating plane: equal to the D0008A 1.75 mm maximum
Standoff: body underside at 0.099 mm, just below the D0008A 0.11 mm minimum standoff; a cosmetic difference of a generic model, recorded rather than corrected
Axis and orientation: long body axis along y as in the footprint; the pin-1 label dot lies in the -x / +VRML-y quadrant, which is KiCad's -x / -y quadrant of footprint pad 1
Transform: identity offset, rotation and scale, the same transform the kicad-footprints 8.0.9 footprint applied to this WRL
Pair: STEP and WRL come from the same tag and the same StepUp export
remaining_physical_checks: Physical seating on the land pattern: open, needs an assembly or bench check (fact-tmp1075-cad-physical-fit, NEEDS BENCH)
Solder fillet and joint quality: open, needs an assembly check
Mechanical clearance to neighbouring parts and the enclosure: open, no board or enclosure exists yet
The STEP body has not been compared with a TI mechanical model: TI publishes none in this record's evidence

publication.permitted_scope: CC-BY-SA 4.0 with the KiCad library exception (LICENSE.md of the library at the pinned tag); redistribution of the libraries as a collection is not covered by the exception. See NOTICE.md.
